Fisher's exact test for score-trait association

scores.fisher.test.Rd

Performs a Fisher's exact test between each score, binarised at its median into High/Low groups (a score equal to the median is "Low"), and a categorical trait. Significant features are plotted as barplots and saved to the "Results/" folder (Results/Fisher_<trait>_<feature>.pdf). The statistic reported is the odds ratio for a two-group trait (NA otherwise).

Usage

scores.fisher.test(scores, coldata, trait, pval = 0.05, padj = FALSE)

Arguments

scores

A samples x features score matrix, a list whose first element is that matrix (e.g. the output of construct_cell_groups()), or the output of compute.latent_factors() (its factor scores Z are tested).

coldata

A data frame (or tibble) containing sample-level annotations including the trait to test. Its rows are matched to the samples of the scores by row name; without sample names, they must be in the order of the scores. Samples with a missing trait are left out (with a message).

trait

Character. Name of the column in coldata to test (categorical, two or more groups).

pval

Numeric. Threshold for significance: a feature is significant if its (adjusted) p-value is <= pval (default = 0.05).

padj

Logical; if TRUE, the p-values are corrected for multiple testing across the features with the Benjamini-Hochberg method, and the adjusted p-values are compared with the threshold. Default FALSE.

Value

See scores.ttest().

Examples

data("network.tuto")
data("deconv_subgroups.tuto")
data("traitdata.tuto")
cell_groups <- construct_cell_groups(network.tuto, deconv_subgroups.tuto)
#> Warning: Length of color vector was shorter than the number of clusters - color vector was recycled
#> Warning: Length of color vector was shorter than the number of clusters - color vector was recycled
#> Warning: Length of color vector was shorter than the number of clusters - color vector was recycled
#> Warning: Length of color vector was shorter than the number of clusters - color vector was recycled
#> Warning: Length of color vector was shorter than the number of clusters - color vector was recycled
#> Warning: Length of color vector was shorter than the number of clusters - color vector was recycled
#> Warning: Length of color vector was shorter than the number of clusters - color vector was recycled
#> Warning: Length of color vector was shorter than the number of clusters - color vector was recycled
#> Dendrogram plots saved to: Results/Dendrogram_color_clusters.pdf
#> 44 of 897 features were not assigned to any cluster by the tree cut and are not part of any cell group (pink: 2, yellow: 8, red: 2, blue: 6, brown: 4, turquoise: 12, black: 4, green: 6)
res <- scores.fisher.test(cell_groups$Cell_groups[, 1:5], traitdata.tuto, "binaryResponse")
#> 1 significant feature(s) after Fisher's exact test (p-value <= 0.05): Dendrogram_pink_group_3
res$Statistics
#>                   feature                test statistic_name statistic

#> 4 Dendrogram_pink_group_4 Fisher's exact test     odds ratio 1.9267619
#> 5 Dendrogram_pink_group_5 Fisher's exact test     odds ratio 0.7590797
#>      p_value p_adjusted significant
